card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The first digit or opening bracket of a section number in a cross-reference such as (5.3) or (2.2, 2.3), plus a few spots just before a number or after a drug name in chemistry or label text.

modes.label: Section number digits
modes.description: The leading digit or space inside a parenthesized section reference in label text.

modes.label: Bracket after drug name
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a brand name, followed by a section number or generic name.

modes.label: Chemistry text
modes.description: The word of in a lab procedure naming a chemical reaction.
modes.example: sodium borohydride reduction<< of>> ethyl acetoacetate

card.writes: It pushes toward chemical and mineral names such as gypsum, manganese and magnesium, and away from web-layout tokens.
card.plain: It fires on the numbers in label cross-references like (5.3), and weakly on some chemistry wording.
